failure.title: Frontend tests imported backend internals outside approved adapters
failure.note: The retained boundary output names two frontend test files that directly imported backend agent and server packages outside the approved frontend server/API adapter boundary.
failure.diagnosis: Gateway resilience and logger-redaction assertions were behaviorally valid but placed in frontend-owned test files, causing presentation tests to cross the documented server-only backend boundary.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
